description: Bifolio of accounting for the purchase of wax (sharḥ shary al-shamʿ). Mentions Nuʿmān; pepper; the word אכדת is spelled אכת; selling a turban to Salāma; the term tashmīʿ (presumably somethign to do with wax); the customs at Dār Mānak and other payments. The right page of recto is headed "explanation of the indigo which I left [in] Almeria with Abū ʿUmar b. BQNṢ(?)
description_he: חשבון, מוזכרים שמות שונים, סחורות ומחירים.
